name: Build and Deploy MLOps Infrastructure

on:
  # Manual trigger with environment dropdown
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: "Choose environment to deploy to"
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - dev
          - prd

  # Automatic trigger for dev environment on push to main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

env:
  # If manually triggered → use dropdown
  # If push to main → default to dev
  SELECTED_ENV: ${{ github.event.inputs.environment || 'dev' }}

  # Account IDs provided via GitHub Secrets (one per environment)
  ACCOUNT_ID_DEV: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_DEV }}
  ACCOUNT_ID_PRD: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_PRD }}

vars:
  # Select the correct account ID based on environment
  ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ inputs.environment == 'prd' && secrets.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_PRD || secrets.AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_DEV }}

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials using OIDC
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}:role/terraform-${{ env.SELECTED_ENV }}
          aws-region: us-west-2

      - name: Log in to Amazon ECR
        run: |
          aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | \
          docker login --username AWS --password-stdin ${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t students-model .

      - name: Tag Docker image
        run: |
          docker tag students-model:latest \
            ${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/students-model-${{ env.SELECTED_ENV }}:latest

      - name: Push Docker image to ECR
        run: |
          docker push ${{ env.ACCOUNT_ID }}.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/students-model-${{ env.SELECTED_ENV }}:latest

      - name: Trigger Terraform Cloud Run
        run: |
          curl \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.TF_API_TOKEN }}" \
            --header "Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json" \
            --request POST \
            --data "{
              \"data\": {
                \"type\": \"runs\",
                \"attributes\": {
                  \"message\": \"Triggered from GitHub Actions for environment: ${{ env.SELECTED_ENV }}\",
                  \"is-destroy\": false
                },
                \"relationships\": {
                  \"workspace\": {
                    \"data\": {
                      \"type\": \"workspaces\",
                      \"name\": \"grades-predictor-${{ env.SELECTED_ENV }}\"
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }" \
            https://app.terraform.io/api/v2/runs
